label: Bridge premise: whatever a society founded as a teaching authority by a…, by Veracity applied to…
meaning: What a teaching authority founded by a God with the classical attributes definitively proposes as revealed, that God confirms, and what he confirms is true; so the authority definitively proposes only truths. Decomposes the stage-3 truth bridge into the confirmation link and the veracity premise; each is needed (omission models in NAMING-VERACITY-BATCH1-CONTROLS).
